verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents BYOC deployments, which let a customer keep data in their own cloud environment. It also documents namespace copies that work across regions and across cloud providers (AWS to GCP), which implies data lives in a specific region and provider. Neither item explicitly documents letting a user choose a storage region or meet a residency requirement. Missing for 10: an explicit region-selection mechanism, a list of available regions or residency guarantees (e.g. EU-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
